headline: Site visit to city operations and facilities to prepare for the Fiscal Year 2028 budget.
summary: Some members may attend the visit. It is meant to help them understand how city operations and facilities work before budget work begins.
items: Site visit to learn about city operations and facilities for budget preparation
location: City of Winooski Department of Public Works building, 200 Gilbrook road
item_action_words: No official City Council actions will occur
plain_text:
Notice of Quorum - Winooski City Council
l A quorum of Winooski City Councilors may attend a site visit to the City of Winooski 
Department of Public Works building located at 200 Gilbrook road on Friday, 
December 11, 2026, at 12 PM. The site visit is to prepare for the Fiscal Year 2028 
budget process by better understanding municipal operations and facilities. No 
official City Council actions will occur; this notice meets the Vermont Open Meeting 
Law requirement.
